title: Team file review and sharing
goal: Run an independent local Python and SQLite file-sharing website with colleague review, designated recipients, authenticated access, and VibeLens observation.

sources.text: 我要做一个小团队的文件共享网页。上传后交给同事审核，审核通过才能分享给指定的人，文件只能登录后访问。先在本机用 Python 和 SQLite 跑起来，我想用 VibeLens 看里面怎么运转。先把需要确认的需求跟我聊清楚，再开始实现。
sources.locator: Current chat, initial user request; complete original preserved in review/design-dialogue.md#u_initial-original-user-request

sources.text: VibeLens 的两种接入方式都会维护流程图和运行记录：drive 让程序按状态声明执行；observe 让程序自己处理业务，VibeLens 观察实际执行。这个工程选哪一种？
sources.locator: Current chat, first clarification panel, question 1; review/design-dialogue.md

sources.text: 上传后，审核人由谁确定？审核人能否审核自己上传的文件？审核通过后，由谁选择接收人并发起分享？
sources.locator: Current chat, first clarification panel, question 2; review/design-dialogue.md

sources.text: 你说的“访问文件”需要哪些能力：查看文件信息、下载、网页预览？另外，上传者和审核人在审核通过前是否可以读取文件内容？

networks.title: File review and recipient access

networks.outcome: An approved file is shared with designated people who must sign in before access; exact authority and access capabilities remain open.

decisions.question: VibeLens 的两种接入方式都会维护流程图和运行记录：drive 让程序按状态声明执行；observe 让程序自己处理业务，VibeLens 观察实际执行。这个工程选哪一种？
decisions.why: The explicit mode choice determines whether the application executes the state declaration or exposes its own authoritative execution.

options.label: Observe application execution
options.effect: The application owns its business logic; VibeLens observes actual execution.

options.label: Execute the state declaration
options.effect: A project-local executor consumes the state declaration; VibeLens records execution.

decisions.question: 上传后，审核人由谁确定？审核人能否审核自己上传的文件？审核通过后，由谁选择接收人并发起分享？
decisions.why: Review assignment, self-review, and sharing authority determine the actual permission rules and cannot be inferred from colleague review.

decisions.why: Recipient access capabilities and pre-approval content access have distinct permission rules.
